text:
InfraBot: INCIDENT P1 — GPU capacity exhaustion detected in eu-west-1. Autoscaler failing to add nodes; GPU queue growth observed. Pager triggered.
PagerDuty: Pager: On-call: @Darren you're up. High queue length for gpu-workload. Immediate mitigation required.
Darren: pinging in. seeing surge. can someone post autoscaler logs?
Aisha: grabbing logs from cluster. gist from cluster-autoscaler: `ERROR: unable to join ASG: LaunchTemplate version mismatch` and `ERROR: InsufficientInstanceCapacity`. also repeated `Failed to attach IAM instance profile` in cloud provider events.
Ben: echoed. cloud shows `Client.UnauthorizedOperation` during instance profile attach attempts — looks like an IAM policy change earlier today.
Carla: customer impact: ~12 production inference jobs throttled, 3 client timeouts reported in the last 8m. informing support to pre-emptively notify affected customers.
Darren: next steps — bypass autoscaler by manually increasing ASG desired capacity to relieve queue while we debug. @Aisha please try: `aws autoscaling set-desired-capacity --auto-scaling-group-name gpu-pool-eu --desired-capacity 8 --honor-cooldown`.
Aisha: running command now. returning: `{\n  "ActivityId": "a1b2c3d4-..."\n}`.
InfraBot: ASG desired capacity increased to 8 (manual override). Instances are provisioning.
Ben: preparing fallback: creating a temporary nodegroup via eksctl in case ASG keep failing. command:
```
eksctl create nodegroup --cluster redwood-eu --name temp-gpu-fallback --node-type p3.2xlarge --nodes 2
```
Carla: throttling low-priority batch workers and rerouting non-critical infer traffic to hosted fallback to slow queue growth. scaled `batch-worker` deployment from 10 -> 2 replicas.
Darren: `kubectl get nodes` shows new nodes stuck `NotReady`. kubelet logs: `error fetching signed url for instance profile` — IAM attach failing at instance bootstrap.
Aisha: inspecting IAM console: role `redwood-gpu-node` had an inline policy change earlier that removed `iam:PassRole` permission. reverting change now.
Ben: while IAM change propagates, we can untaint a couple of CPU nodes to accept critical pods as a temporary measure: `kubectl taint nodes cpu-spot-1 gpu-only:NoSchedule-` and `kubectl taint nodes cpu-spot-2 gpu-only:NoSchedule-`.
Darren: applied taint removal on cpu-spot-1 and cpu-spot-2. scheduler is placing small GPU-tolerant pods onto those nodes.
Aisha: IAM revert finished. new EC2 instances moved to InService and joined the cluster at t+9m. kubelet registered successfully.
Carla: queue size decreased from ~240 -> ~90 following manual ASG bump and throttles. customer error rate down to baseline. continuing to monitor.
InfraBot: Note: creating fallback nodegroup hit a vCPU quota limit; filed AWS support ticket #123456 to increase quotas for the account.
Ben: autoscaler debug: failure root cause appears to be a recently published launch template revision that references a deprecated AMI and incompatible user-data (drift). autoscaler couldn't apply the LT version and fell back, triggering `InsufficientInstanceCapacity` and launch errors. scheduling rollback.
Darren: rolling launch template default version back to v42: `aws ec2 modify-launch-template --launch-template-id lt-0abc123 --default-version 42`.
Aisha: executed. cluster-autoscaler retried and successfully launched instances after LT rollback.
Carla: running quick smoke tests on customer inference paths — no new errors in the last 5m. support notified customers that mitigation is in progress and being validated.
Darren: stabilization checklist: (1) pin LT revision in infra CI to avoid accidental drift, (2) audit IAM policy change path to prevent late-day inline edits, (3) update runbook with manual ASG bump + taint workaround and eksctl fallback steps. I'll own items 1 & 3.
Ben: I'll follow up on the quota ticket, remove temp fallback nodegroup once cluster is healthy, and open a post-incident infra PR.
Aisha: creating incident postmortem doc and linking logs + commands used. will add timeline and mitigation notes.
PagerDuty: Incident acknowledged closed by @Darren after stabilization. :white_check_mark:
InfraBot: Incident summary archived to /incidents/1988654321 with tags: gpu, autoscaling, iam, launch-template, mitigation.
Carla: thanks team. leaving a follow-up action to run a simulated autoscaler upgrade in staging to catch LT/AMI drift issues. :thumbsup:
